name: Kimi to Boku no Hatsukoi
source:
Yu Miyamura is in love with his upperclassman Takato Kujo.

The clumsy boys write about their twisted first love.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE154287.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
宫村优爱着学长九条贵人。

笨拙的男孩们写下扭曲的初恋故事。

[摘自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE154287.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
